```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(may.pop AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(apr.pop, 0) AS ratio
FROM 
  (SELECT SUM(population) AS pop 
   FROM main.country_history 
   WHERE effective_month = '2026-05' 
     AND code IN (SELECT "Code" FROM main.country WHERE "Continent" = 'Asia')) may,
  (SELECT SUM(population) AS pop 
   FROM main.country_history 
   WHERE effective_month = '2026-04' 
     AND code IN (SELECT "Code" FROM main.country WHERE "Continent" = 'Asia')) apr;
```
